body:
## 25 November: parallel mathematical attacks and a checked Lean checkpoint

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This update contains new proofs and full-problem attempts, with the precise difference between compiled Lean declarations, written deductions, and open closing steps preserved.

- Published head: `4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1`.
- Scientific commit: `632cb06b6770c2e0cb1c95fcdcfd022638c488bb`; the following commit adds publication receipts only.
- [New scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/research/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/README.md).
- [Sources and exact scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/research/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/SOURCES.md).
- [Root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/reports/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/ROOT_REVIEW.md).

Four GPT-6.2 Astra agents at ultra reasoning pursued arithmetic, Fourier, ordinary descent, and closing synthesis, with independent reconstruction between lanes. The refreshed inventory contains 169 all-state PR records. Targeted mathematical intake froze PR195 at `99a4ab3f808c01acd115ef08eee42a8b886d5d4c`, PR192 at `1f1d3d690d7517e1b2a44b5f2f4930bd45b63302`, PR201 at `02fb390a76fb2ffb00fee612649ca23a82d99d31`, PR210 at `592328fecf8ea2cf41736294856d95f890a1ba98`, and PR197 at `10d87fee615d1095990d6b7ea329126b4cf7aa5a`. No whole-branch audit of those proposals is claimed.

### The carry bound applies to every ordinary source

For the shortcut carry defined by $2^N T^N(a)=3^{P_N(a)}a+C_N(a)$, fix any finite prime set S containing two and three. The arithmetic note proves
$
a H_S(C_N(a))\ge 2^{(1-\epsilon)N}
$
for every positive a and all sufficiently large N, with onset depending only on S and epsilon. H_S is the outside-S numerator part, with H_S(0)=1. A stronger product applies to sources of exponential height, in particular giving the carry-only bound for ternary towers of linear depth. The proof uses the finite-place Subspace Theorem on the literal source and carry.

The two-window version retains one actual hypothetical escape and arbitrary boundedly many parts of its carry discrepancy. The symbolic applications exclude escaping positive realizations of arbitrary nonerasing encodings of every k-Bonacci word and the other stated balanced-pair families. The ordinary affine and dyadic identities are Lean-checked; the imported Subspace Theorem and these analytic deductions are written proofs.

### The complete determinant, including a changing high-degree factor

The cycle synthesis bounds the gcd of every proper arc carry with the full determinant when its distinct odd endpoints have polynomial height. It also proves irreducibility and absence of dilation for degree-(p-1) single-raised-rank polynomials. The new uniform theorem gives
$
\log\gcd(2^h-3^p,Q_s(u))=O(p^{5/6})
$
at all moving interior ranks under the stated coprime near-critical clocks. Two short relations, the finite-rank unit-equation theorem of Evertse–Schlickewei–Schmidt, and a nonzero resultant retain prime-power divisibility. This controls the full reduced denominator on genuine positive rational cycles of this family. Arbitrary high-complexity masks still lack the required second polynomial. Both cycle notes received an independent written review.

### Uniform Fourier cancellation and whole-orbit branch restrictions

The global note derives an additive Fourier saving $N/(\log N)^{1/96}$, uniform over every frequency and interval, for the actual bad mark or any fixed odd target's visit mark after centering by its current row mean. It uses the cited ordinary merger estimate and two-logarithm input. Together with fixed-target positive lower density, it counts positive proportions of free pairs visiting three prescribed targets at x,y,x+y. The exact diagonal fails for 5,5,85, and the bad-mark Fejer norm must grow at least as a logarithmic power. No incompatible upper bound is obtained.

The closing synthesis applies one first-landing estimate to all branches entering one escaping odd orbit. With $r_j=1-d_{a_{j-1}}/d_{a_j}$, it proves $\sum r_j^{q_*}<\infty$ for some absolute $q_*<H_2(\log_3 2)$, plus summability of complete reverse-transition entropies. A separate deterministic bound controls all source arrival clocks: at density-one odd clocks j, every positive x at most $j^{1/H_2(\log_3 2)}$ reaching $a_j$ has already visited $a_{j-1}$. The simultaneous-section extension covers one chosen ray in each escaping component and all cycles. The required lower branch-loss floor on the same orbit remains open. These deductions retain the cited analytic source qualifications.

### A kernel-checked descent obstruction and its explicit exit

For every fixed upper horizon I and margin D, sufficiently deep ternary divisibility forces every smaller rival into the qualifying early endpoint to use more than i+h+D odd departures, with **no bound on the rival's clock**. The proof extracts a genuine bounded ordinary residual path.

For every odd x divisible by 243, the smaller triple $192(x/243)-3$ reaches $(x-1)/2$ in seven shortcuts and exactly four odd departures. The source-specific checker consumer is included. On the stated Mersenne family, moving the upper endpoint by one physical step changes an unbounded rival-work obstruction into a certificate with four extra odd steps. The explicit numerical threshold uses the exact finite seed replay and is distinguished from the general Lean theorem.

### Checks actually run

- All seven new Lean modules and three resident imports rebuilt into a fresh project-object directory with Lean 4.34.1 and pinned cached Mathlib dependencies.
- **29 new public theorem declarations; 60 total axiom audits including imports.** Only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, or subsets. No sorryAx or custom project axiom in those inventories.
- Both new finite scripts run normally and with -O, byte-identical outputs: 2,560 actual two-window comparisons, four unequal-clock rotation controls, and 454,255 positive seed/clock pairs over the seed set below 3^8.
- Scientific source manifest checked against the fetched published tree; compiled source hashes match the root receipt.
- Required repository validator passed in clean complete local and fetched published checkouts. The final tree contains 747 tracked files. Integrity validation is not mathematical verification.

[Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/reports/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/LEAN.json) · [Finite receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/reports/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/FINITE.json) · [Publication receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/4cc06e7d8fdec923eed73a26b1e9d680c9f701d1/reports/astra-multiple-attacks-20261125/PUBLICATION.json)

The final universal source-coverage clause and unrestricted cycle-denominator exclusion are explicitly unproved. The existing conditional Lean proposal is unchanged.

## 25 November: ordinary residue merger and a global Fourier criterion

**Collatz remains OPEN. This update does not supply an unconditional final Lean proof.** Four explicitly selected GPT-6.2 Astra agents pursued source-dependent descent, cycle arithmetic, forward escape, and a separate global literature route. The mathematical evidence is the source, independent reconstruction, exact controls and kernel replay.

[New proof packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/README.md) · [Final Lean proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/FinalProposal.lean) · [Root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/reports/astra-closure-20261125/ROOT_REVIEW.md)

### New ordinary theorem and its actual minimality application

For the shortcut map \(T(2n)=n,\ T(2n+1)=3n+2\), every odd positive
\(s\equiv187605073\pmod{3^{19}}\) has a positive multiple of three \(y<2s+1\) with \(T^{30}(y)=T(s)\). The complete family is

\[
s=187605073+2324522934t,\qquad
y=259975167+3221225472t,\qquad t\ge0.
\]

Lean verifies the 19-odd-departure parity lift and the actual least-bad-triple consumer. If \(3q=2s+1\) is the least bad positive multiple of three and its component contains \(s\), this smaller multiple gives a contradiction. The ordinary component hypothesis is explicit. The endpoint \(T(s)\) need not be odd.

This merger defeats the same rational-cycle family that simultaneously passed the full stated depth-16/17 ancestor guards and finite-prime local-integrality tests. It does not exclude every remaining word or basin.

[Certificate and deeper search](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/cycles/MERGER.md) · [Lean certificate](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/cycles/NineteenMerger.lean)

### Global literature route

For the actual nonconvergence indicator \(b(n)\), form the symmetric Fejér polynomials
\(K_N(t)=\sum_{|k|<N}(1-|k|/N)b(|k|)e^{2\pi i kt}\).
A bounded lower limit of their integral norms gives a finite convolution-idempotent measure. The Cohen–Helson–Rudin theorem makes its Fourier support eventually periodic. A new Lean theorem proves that any eventually periodic coloring preserved by the exact shortcut branches is constant on the positive integers. The final consumer connects this arithmetic theorem to the actual convergence predicate.

The written argument proves the exact identity

\[
\|K_{2N}\|_1-\|K_N\|_1
=\int (|K_{2N}(t)-K_N(2t)|-|K_N(2t)|)_+\,dt.
\]

**Summability of these dyadic increments for the actual indicator remains unproved.** Adjacent absorption gives only an improved \(O(\sqrt N/(\log N)^{1/8})\) ceiling. An actual mark for visiting 5 has one defective odd edge and divergent norms despite that ceiling. The source-qualified Fourier equivalence and this control received an independent reconstruction.

[Written global argument](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/global/README.md) · [Lean rigidity](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/research/astra-closure-20261125/global/PeriodicColor.lean) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/aa0b01234735683b413098b81afdf764de503730/reports/astra-closure-20261125/GLOBAL_REVIEW.md)

### Other combined results

- The original all-prefix clock-failure fraction on complete ordinary rows is
  \(\Theta(0.946504577\ldots^n n^{-1.426994557\ldots})\), including any fixed admissible initial history with history-dependent constants. This is a written deduction using Caravenna's conditioned lattice local limit theorem.
- A Lean visit injection controls every failing visit to a supplied odd gate, including cycles. Exact common-gate identities show how the last-crossing selections from an entire predecessor row can coincide.
- The rational-cycle construction cancels full varying prime-power factors at every prime in a fixed finite set, while retaining both rotation orders, full-denominator nonintegrality and the simultaneous finite ancestor guards. It uses source-qualified real and p-adic logarithmic estimates.
- Every fixed two-arm tower deadline is missed by cofinally many actual prescribed powers. Exponentially many maximum-weight finite prefixes have ordinary power realizations. These statements neither assert a divergent power nor realize an infinite ordinary word.

### Final proof boundary

The final Lean proposal proves that a checked smaller-triple merger for every actual first failure would imply convergence for every positive integer. It also proves that eventual periodicity of the actual convergence predicate is equivalent to universal convergence. **Neither universal merger coverage nor the required analytic estimate is supplied.** No open assertion is inserted as an axiom.

### Latest intake and verification

The initial all-state inventory contains 168 PRs, with mathematical intake focused on PR192, PR195, PR197, PR206, PR207, PR208 and PR209 plus resident interfaces. Late PR192 at 07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124 and PR206 at 45a6a111321f947a8482c9e96e898435b57cee09 were incorporated. Their new single-orbit representations and finite tower-merger windows retain explicit universal premises. No upstream replay was run merely to repeat earlier work.

- Lean 4.34.1: **eight new modules**, two resident imports, **36 new public theorems**, **54 total transitive axiom audits**; warnings treated as errors.
- Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. The project objects were rebuilt; the pinned Mathlib dependency cache was reused.
- **Five new exact finite programs passed in both normal and optimized Python**, ten runs. The root mechanical-window replay uses depth 40; the author's larger depth-60 run is identified separately.
- The 61-file science manifest and all ten compiled-source hashes match the published checkout. New local document links were checked.
- The complete published **687-file checkout** passed the five repository integrity commands. These checks do not prove the written analytic claims.
- The first root integration timeout is preserved; the corrected proof kept the same statement and isolated its linear arithmetic.

## Latest checkpoint — ordinary cycle occupation and a full-statement Lean proposal

**Collatz remains OPEN.** Three explicitly selected GPT-6.2 Astra research lanes attempted closure from the least ordinary failure, invariant labels and critical arithmetic. The strongest new written theorem forces a positive fraction of every sufficiently long nontrivial ordinary cycle above twice its minimum. The final Lean theorem is compiled, with universal certificate coverage retained as an explicit unproved hypothesis.

### Main mathematical result

For some absolute p₀, every primitive positive ordinary cycle with odd period p ≥ p₀ and minimum m has **more than p/21 distinct odd phases above 2m**. A possibly smaller absolute positive fraction holds for every nontrivial ordinary cycle.

The proof combines Wu–Wang's actual three-coefficient logarithmic-form Theorem 1 with exact counting of ordinary paths. A prescribed k-step height profile, with terminal interval width at most 3^k, has at most k+1 ordinary sources. The new independent integer proof of that complete capacity bound is kernel checked. An injective reverse code turns a low proportion of high phases into a weak-composition bound. The strict entropy comparison is verified by exact kernel reduction.

The whole asymptotic theorem and the external logarithmic-form theorem remain written mathematics. Two agents and the coordinator reconstructed the new argument. No explicit numerical period onset, whole-cycle exclusion, or priority claim is made.

[Cycle proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/24cdd0e5471d4421716cfce6bd88916f858f994c/research/astra-universal-proof-20261124/critical/CYCLE_OCCUPATION.md) · [Capacity kernel](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/24cdd0e5471d4421716cfce6bd88916f858f994c/research/astra-universal-proof-20261124/minimum/MovingOctaveOrder.lean) · [Profile kernel](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/24cdd0e5471d4421716cfce6bd88916f858f994c/research/astra-universal-proof-20261124/critical/OctaveOccupation.lean)

### Same-phase synchronization and remaining arithmetic

On sufficiently long primitive ordinary cycles, a positive fraction of the physical phases above any chosen height are also strict all-pasts companion records. Their companion values are uniformly bounded and their sufficiently long preceding words are distinct. A deterministic charging inequality proves the overlap at the same phases.

The reduced companion denominator remains separate from the physical cycle denominator. Rotating the latter's carry equations gives equivalent divisibility tests, not independent congruences. That missing arithmetic implication is explicit.

[Synchronization proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/24cdd0e5471d4421716cfce6bd88916f858f994c/research/astra-universal-proof-20261124/critical/COMPANION_SYNCHRONIZATION.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/24cdd0e5471d4421716cfce6bd88916f858f994c/research/astra-universal-proof-20261124/minimum/CYCLE_REVIEW.md)

### Universal Lean interface

The compiled equivalence is universal Collatz convergence iff every 3q, q > 1, actually merges with a smaller positive multiple 3v, with the two clocks independently chosen. Six explicit inverse paths cover every positive integer from a positive multiple of three in at most six shortcut steps.

The finite checker validates a proposed smaller index and both literal ordinary paths. The theorem certified_collatz requires success for **every** q > 1. This packet does not provide a selector with that universal coverage proof. No analytic axiom or admitted proof is used to conceal it.

The other kernels prove the exact repeated-block divisibility clock and the transient ordinary-root coboundary. The corresponding constructions distinguish arbitrarily long finite behavior at changing good lower arms from one fixed all-time source.

## New checkpoint: prescribed pairs and repeated component descent

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This continuation attacks the prescribed-target and exceptional-source steps using three GPT-6.2 Astra research lanes, independent cross-reviews, and coordinator reconstruction. It adds 13 research files and 11 review, audit, and publication files.

### 1. A growing chain of smaller actual ordered representatives

On a row $2^d\le n<2^{d+1}$, even after fixing any $L\le d^{3/5}$ low binary digits, outside a fraction $e^{-d^{1/100}}$ the actual pair $n,3^s n+r$ has an odd unit tripling representative $u$ with
$$n\sim u,\qquad3^s n+r\sim3u,\qquad u\le2^{d^{99/100}}.$$
Here $s,r$ are fixed and $\sim$ denotes ordinary common future, allowing different clocks. The certificate concatenates a growing number of strictly decreasing physical transfers. The proof keeps the original source grid, handles both grade orders, and cancels the inverse-fiber multiplicity against the actual forced binary residue of the child.

This is a **written theorem relative to the pinned PR146 symbolic absorption estimate**. The construction can simultaneously realize every word of prescribed growing ternary residues. With the separate predecessor-density premise M, it reduces convergence to a directed pointwise law on two explicit sparse dyadic progressions near a chosen ternary unit. That pointwise law remains open.

[Full descent proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fbe870ec44239e6b6c753bab9d1c7537acfff701/research/astra-prescribed-closure-20261124/head/README.md) · [Sparse directed criterion](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fbe870ec44239e6b6c753bab9d1c7537acfff701/research/astra-prescribed-closure-20261124/head/PRESCRIBED_RESIDUES.md)

### 2. Both ordinary targets prescribed, with a common dense pattern

For every sufficiently large $N$, one pattern $P_N\subset[0,N-1]$ with $|P_N|\ge cN/\log N$ has arbitrarily large translates in the actual paired inverse tree of **every prescribed positive odd unit pair $(q,5q)$**. Every source in a translate lands at both specified endpoints at a common clock with equal odd counts. The same pattern is chosen before $q$.

The argument obtains tight real offsets at the heavy-tailed renewal epochs, a central clock/grade row, and an ordinary common suffix retaining the entire pattern. It assumes the pinned ratio-five renewal law R. A Kelley–Meka corollary gives many disjoint three-term progressions with differences divisible by a supplied modulus. The interval position and appended clock are not bounded by its length. An exact first-arm row ceiling quantifies why the existing bounded-offset fibers cannot overwhelm an ambient exception at a growing prescribed target.

[Proof, exact pattern and Lean interface](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fbe870ec44239e6b6c753bab9d1c7537acfff701/research/astra-prescribed-closure-20261124/paired/README.md)

### 3. Short prescribed returns and the attempted ternary reset

For actual pairs on $(x,9x+2)$ or $(x,3x)$, arbitrary adaptive short forward returns, even with independently chosen clocks, force synchronized affine returns at large sources. Each observation then exposes a fixed positive merger chance on fresh original bits. Chains reaching a discordant target below $2^{(1-\delta)d}$ while all links have length $o(d^{.99})$ occupy $o(e^{-d^{.01}})$ of the row. General common-future comparisons and long excursions are outside this bound.

The direct closing attempt used high ternary divisibility to contract a sparse unit. On one progression it preserves both components but exactly replays the old paired states after a delay, retaining the forced binary word. On the other it merges the new pair while losing the second supplied label. The ordinary identities are now kernel-checked. Additional explicit comparisons at the ternary center $-1/4$ identify which original component the PR192 contracted representative actually inherits.
